posts.summary_en: 서신우's post-patch Arena guide. Lineup: Bari 5★+ runs Cherry Cola, otherwise Rye; Strawberry Crepe sometimes to melt the first clash, usually Rockstar or Herb. Perks: Passion Pay on Milk with Armor Repair; under merc Lv.4, Health Insurance. Power jumped because Chardonnay deals more than other dealers and buffs crit, and because players moved from Conquest gear to crit RES gear, now essential against her opening burst. His crit RES preset: top-left Skill AMP + crit rate, bottom-left DR + crit RES, top-right Skill AMP + haste, bottom-right haste + crit RES or DR. Runes on screen: Milk ATK AMP x7 + Skill AMP; Rye crit DMG x5 + Skill AMP; Moon Rabbit DR x7 + HP; Chardonnay, Cheesecake and Herb all Skill AMP; Oven Skill Haste + ATK AMP x2 + Skill AMP. Chardonnay: Skill AMP, haste is a matter of taste. Battle: his 32.82M beat 34.51M, rising to 2,454 points and 3rd; his top damage Rye 2.03M, Oven 1.15M, Chardonnay 1.10M, Bari 0.74M.

teams.perks: Armor Repair + Passion Pay (Milk); Health Insurance under merc Lv.4

builds.why: Crit RES is essential against Chardonnay's opening burst
Arena is a burst meta; she doesn't cycle her skill much

mechanics: Arena power rose after 10-08 mostly from Chardonnay and crit RES gear, not the level cap.

quotes.kr: 해당 장비는 차례대로 무기는 증폭, 치확 방어구는 피감, 치저 윗 악세는 증폭, 가속 아래는 가속에 사람에 따라 치저를 가져가는 경우도 있고 여기서는 피감을 챙기는 경우도 있습니다
quotes.en: In order: weapons Skill AMP + crit rate; armour DR + crit RES; upper accessories Skill AMP + haste; lower haste plus crit RES or DR by preference

posts.title_en: New Arena deck with Chardonnay: delete the enemy line
posts.summary_en: 올렐레오로리's cafe post linking the blog post below. Replies by the author: Chardonnay takes Macaron's slot whatever her stars; Bari under 5★ still works with Oven and Cherry Cola, 5★+ is better; replace Oven with Rye if needed; Pomegranate's first skill hits three fixed targets, Chardonnay and Milk by Projectile Speed, so give the third to Bari or Oven; lately the author swaps Herb for Rye and battles are fast again.
mechanics: Pomegranate's first skill has three fixed targets: Projectile Speed receivers first.

posts.title_en: Chardonnay is out: the new recommended Arena deck (올렐레옹 blog)
posts.summary_en: The deck: Bari, Oven Wanderer and Cherry Cola deal; Ion, Cake Hound and Moon Rabbit tank; Cheesecake, Herb, Milk, Pomegranate and Pinot buff; Chardonnay in Macaron's old slot. At max stars her crit buff equals Macaron's but lands fast on a wide line with push RES and needs no stacking, so even low-star Chardonnay beats Macaron in Arena. Perks: Passion Pay fixed; Armor Repair against strong opponents, Rapid Promotion against weak ones. Runes: Skill AMP first (push RES ignores it); haste unnecessary because her 5 s buff outlasts the 4 s cooldown.

builds.why: Crit buff scales with Skill AMP; 5 s duration over a 4 s cooldown

quotes.kr: 성급이 낮아도 마카롱 자리에는 이제 샤르도네맛 쿠키를 쓰는게 훨씬 좋아
quotes.en: Even at low stars, Chardonnay is far better in Macaron's slot now

posts.summary_en: A general rune list in priority order (all modes): Chardonnay Skill AMP; Rye Skill AMP, crit DMG, ATK AMP; Bari Skill AMP, haste, DR; Oven Skill AMP, DR or HP; Cherry Cola Skill AMP, crit DMG, DR, ATK AMP; Moon Rabbit haste, focus, DR; Hound haste, HP / DR / RES; Ion HP, DR, ATK AMP; Pinot focus, haste, DR; Milk ATK AMP. Author: Chardonnay's crit buff grows with Skill AMP.

quotes.en: Raise the crit buff with Skill AMP

posts.title_en: Did you know Rumble allows force-quitting?
posts.summary_en: Force-quitting a Rumble battle works, unlike Arena. Replies: the result is decided at the start; 100 replays give the same death order and damage.
mechanics: A battle's outcome is fixed at its start; force-quitting doesn't change it (replies).

quotes.en: Even after 100 runs the result was the same
